parts.text: In this experiment, you are to investigate the cooling of thermometer bulbs under different conditions. Carry out the following instructions referring to Fig. 2.1. You are provided with two thermometers, A and B . Thermometer B has cotton wool wrapped around the bulb. Do not remove this cotton wool. Fig. 2.1

parts.label: i
parts.text: (a) (i) Place thermometer A in the beaker of hot water. Measure θ , the temperature of the water. Record θ in Table 2.1 at time t = 0 s.

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Remove the thermometer from the water, starting the stopclock as you do so. Record in Table 2.1 the temperature θ of the thermometer bulb at 30 s intervals until you have a total of seven values. Table 2.1 Thermometer A Thermometer B t / θ / θ /

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Repeat steps (i) and (ii) using thermometer B .

parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) Complete Table 2.1 by inserting the appropriate unit in each of the time and temperature column headings. [6]
